clue.text: Stir up trouble in Tube, which is illuminating

indicators.note: when things are up they are in disorder, so the word before it is jumbled

parts.note: a plight is a troubled situation

explanation.surface: Someone causing a commotion on the London Underground, an enlightening experience.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tube here is not the London Underground but a long fluorescent lamp; the wordplay sits inside the definition's surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A strip light is a long fluorescent lamp shaped as a glass cylinder giving off brightness.

clue.text: Impression of marine mammal

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a stamp pressed into wax
second meaning: a flippered animal of the coasts

explanation.surface: An impressionist doing an impersonation of a sea creature.
explanation.definitionFit: A seal is both an embossed stamp pressed into wax and a flippered sea creature that basks on rocks.

clue.text: Nearly ready to burst

indicators.note: nearly means not quite all, so the final letter of the next word is dropped

parts.note: fruit that is ready to eat is ripe

explanation.surface: Something swollen almost at bursting point.
explanation.definitionFit: To rip is to tear open suddenly, much as a seam or bag splits apart under strain.

clue.text: Guide one in bed

indicators.note: one thing lying in another means it is placed inside it

parts.note: a garden bed is a plot of ground

explanation.surface: Steering someone who is lying in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: Bed is the garden kind, not the bedroom kind.
explanation.definitionFit: A pilot steers ships into harbour, so to pilot is to guide or lead the way.

clue.text: Cheeky reason to be allowed into party office of Islamic leader

definitions.text: Cheeky reason to be allowed into party
definitions.note: a phrase, I'M A MATE, read as one word
definitions.meaning: first meaning: what a gatecrasher tells the doorman
second meaning: the position held by a prayer leader in a mosque

explanation.surface: A gatecrasher's excuse at the door of a party.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as I'M A MATE, it is the line a gatecrasher tries on the bouncer.
explanation.definitionFit: An imam leads prayers in a mosque, and the -ate suffix names the office or rank, as in episcopate.

clue.text: Henry right to hide most of lager for cheeky individual

indicators.note: letters that hide something keep it within them
most of means everything but the end, so the final letter goes

parts.note: H is the symbol of the henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: Henry, in the right, conceals some beer from a cheeky person.
explanation.walkthrough: Amstel is a Dutch beer brand. The hamster is cheeky because it stuffs food into its cheek pouches.
explanation.definitionFit: Hamsters carry food in pouches in their cheeks, so the cheeky individual is a playful description of the rodent.

clue.text: Purple swelling quietly moved to the head

indicators.note: the soft musical marking at the end is shifted round to the front of the word

explanation.surface: A purple bruise that has risen up to someone's head.
explanation.walkthrough: Quietly is P, the musical piano; the P already ending LUMP moves to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Plum is a dark reddish-purple colour, named after the ripe fruit.

clue.text: Sign from railway shed in book store

indicators.note: to shed something is to cast it off, so those letters are removed

parts.note: a library is a store of books

explanation.surface: A notice taken from a railway shed and kept in a bookshop.
explanation.walkthrough: Shed looks like a building beside the railway, but it is a verb meaning cast off.
explanation.definitionFit: Libra, the scales, is one of the twelve signs of the zodiac.

clue.text: Indulge Mrs Mills in malicious gossip

definitions.note: elliptical: the answer is one who indulges in malicious gossip

indicators.note: a mill grinds what goes in, so the preceding letters are ground up and reshaped

explanation.surface: An invitation to gossip spitefully about a Mrs Mills.
explanation.walkthrough: Mrs Mills looks like one name (she was a famous British pub pianist); the name splits, and Mills is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A mudslinger throws dirt at others' reputations, the very person who indulges in malicious gossip.

clue.text: Proposals tackling logjam oddly becoming theoretical matter

indicators.note: one tackling something gets hold of it, wrapping round it
oddly points to the letters in odd-numbered positions

explanation.surface: Suggestions for breaking a deadlock that turn into theory rather than practice.
explanation.definitionFit: An ideal gas is a hypothetical gas obeying the gas laws exactly, a physicists' model rather than real substance.

clue.text: Horrify father with twisting and lap-dancing

indicators.note: twisting turns the word round so it reads the other way

parts.note: pa is a familiar word for father

indicators.note: dancing letters move about and land in a new order

explanation.surface: Dad dancing the twist and lap-dancing would mortify anyone.
explanation.definitionFit: To appal is to fill with dismay or shock, just as to horrify does.

clue.text: I see Eccles spot advertisement for Indian city

parts.note: the setter is speaking of himself
a dab is a small spot of something

explanation.surface: The setter notices a promotional poster for a city in India.
explanation.walkthrough: Eccles is the setter's pseudonym, so his name stands for ME.
explanation.definitionFit: Ahmedabad is the largest city in the state of Gujarat in western India.

clue.text: Lengthen professional pamphlet

parts.note: a tract is a short pamphlet, often religious

explanation.surface: Padding out a booklet written by an expert.
explanation.definitionFit: To protract something is to draw it out so it takes longer than necessary.

clue.text: Become weak when making schedules

parts.note: to rot is to decay and weaken

explanation.surface: Losing strength while drawing up timetables.
explanation.definitionFit: A rota is a list setting out who does which duty when, a kind of timetable.

clue.text: Use a mask in audition

indicators.note: an audition is a hearing, so the word is taken by its sound

explanation.surface: An actor wearing a mask while trying out for a part.
explanation.walkthrough: Audition suggests a stage tryout; here it simply means hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Avail as a noun means benefit or use, as in 'to no avail'.

clue.text: Analogy from school getting a denial to teacher raised

parts.note: a comprehensive school, in British shorthand

indicators.note: in a down entry raising something lifts it to read from the bottom upward

parts.note: pupils' name for a male teacher

explanation.surface: A school story in which a pupil says no to a teacher.
explanation.walkthrough: A comp is a British state comprehensive school. 'No, sir' is the denial given to the teacher, and that pair goes upward.
explanation.definitionFit: An analogy draws a likeness between two things, which is a comparison.

clue.text: Slight in poem welcoming Rwandan initially ignored

indicators.note: welcoming something means taking it inside

parts.note: an ode is a lyric poem

indicators.note: the first letter is ignored, so it drops away

parts.note: the Tutsi are a people of Rwanda

explanation.surface: A poem about Rwanda that leaves a Rwandan out.
explanation.definitionFit: An outside chance is a slight or remote one, so outside can mean small or unlikely.

clue.text: I am cherished before I develop skin infection

parts.note: a pet is a cherished favourite
to go is to progress or proceed

explanation.surface: Someone loved and pampered before coming down with a rash.
explanation.definitionFit: Impetigo is a contagious bacterial skin infection causing crusty sores, common in children.

clue.text: Schedule of émigré broadcast by nationalist

indicators.note: broadcast seed is scattered widely, so these letters are strewn into a new order

parts.note: the letters as written, accents dropped

explanation.surface: The broadcasting timetable of an exile working for a nationalist cause.
explanation.definitionFit: A regimen is a prescribed plan of diet, exercise or treatment followed to a set schedule.

clue.text: Intended average temperature

parts.note: the arithmetic mean is an average

explanation.surface: A weather report giving the planned typical reading.
explanation.definitionFit: Meant, the past tense of mean, describes something done on purpose or designed.

clue.text: Be quiet entering platform with no line or safety rail

indicators.note: entering something means going inside it
having no line means that letter is taken out

explanation.surface: A call for silence on a railway platform where there is no line or barrier.
explanation.walkthrough: Platform and line suggest a station; the platform is a preacher's. A pushpit is the guardrail at a yacht's stern, the partner of the pulpit at the bow.
explanation.definitionFit: On a yacht the pushpit is the raised guardrail round the stern, keeping crew from falling overboard.

clue.text: Feline climbing on part of roof is touchy-feely

indicators.note: climbing in a down clue means reading upward, back to front

explanation.surface: A cat on a hot tin roof, scrambling up and wanting affection.
explanation.definitionFit: Tactile describes someone who likes physical contact such as hugging, as touchy-feely does.

clue.text: Manipulate communication with American for leading European

indicators.note: one thing given for another takes its place
the leading letter of a word is the one at its front

explanation.surface: Spinning a news story by putting an American in place of the European in the lead.
explanation.definitionFit: To massage is to knead and manipulate muscles; figuratively, to massage figures is to manipulate them.

clue.text: Unnamed Liberal's routine

indicators.note: a liberal treatment is free and loose, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An anonymous Liberal Democrat politician's daily habits.
explanation.definitionFit: Mundane means dull and ordinary, as routine does when describing everyday tasks.

clue.text: Restore official with indefinable charisma

parts.note: a referee is a match official
'it' is that special quality, as in an It girl

explanation.surface: An official with a certain something brought back to the job.
explanation.definitionFit: To refit a ship or building is to renovate and repair it, bringing it back to good condition.

clue.text: Feel just about functional at last

indicators.note: about means going round, so one piece surrounds another
at last points to the word's final letter

explanation.surface: Feeling barely able to function, finally.
explanation.walkthrough: Just about reads as 'nearly'; split, just is the piece and about the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A flair for something is a natural feel or instinct for it, a knack.

clue.text: Entrance to church on Greek island is composite material

indicators.note: the entrance is the way in, so the first letter is used

explanation.surface: The doorway of a church on a Greek island is built of rubble and cement.
explanation.definitionFit: Concrete is a mixture of cement, sand, gravel and water, a classic composite building material.

clue.text: Express's Sally hosting leader in private

indicators.note: a host has a guest inside

parts.note: a sally is a sudden attack

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A train named the Express with a woman called Sally giving a private party.
explanation.walkthrough: Sally looks like a woman's name; it is a sortie. Express's is short for express is, the definition plus the link.
explanation.definitionFit: An express train or delivery is fast, so the word means rapid.

clue.text: Reportedly, Scottish bank hit hard in Northern England

indicators.note: reportedly means as spoken, so the word is judged by its sound

parts.note: brae is Scots for a hillside or bank

explanation.surface: A news story about a Scottish bank that suffered badly in the north of England.
explanation.walkthrough: Bank sounds financial but is a slope. Bray is northern dialect for beating hard.
explanation.definitionFit: In northern English dialect to bray is to thrash or hit hard, as well as to make a donkey's noise.

clue.text: Husband left separately, overwhelmed by fruit punch in Asian utopia

indicators.note: separately means the two single letters are not kept together but placed at different points
being overwhelmed means being engulfed, so these go inside

explanation.surface: A husband walking out alone after one too many glasses of punch on a dream holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: Separately means the two letters go into different places, not side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: Shangri-La is the hidden Himalayan paradise of James Hilton's novel Lost Horizon, now any earthly paradise.

clue.text: Influence Penny to be in the red car, ultimately

parts.note: being in the red means owing money

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: Penny is persuaded to get into debt over a red car.
explanation.walkthrough: Penny looks like a woman's name; it is the coin abbreviation. The red is debt, not a car's colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Power is the capacity to influence people or events, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Group of ladies close in on victory

parts.note: the Women's Institute, a British organisation of women

indicators.note: the close of a word is its end, so its last letter

explanation.surface: A women's club closing in on a triumph.
explanation.walkthrough: Close in reads as approach; close is the selector and in the word it works on.
explanation.definitionFit: Winning a match or contest means coming out on top, so the noun is a simple synonym for triumph.

clue.text: Generously accommodates legendary fiddler

indicators.note: the word before houses the answer within its letters

explanation.surface: Someone generous enough to put up a famous violinist.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman emperor Nero is said to have fiddled while Rome burned, though the story is legend.

clue.text: Fairness is having writer and director instead of Charlie in Jersey?

indicators.note: one thing in place of another means a swap

explanation.surface: A question of fair play when a writer and director replace Charlie in a Jersey production.
explanation.walkthrough: Jersey is a British Crown dependency, a self-governing island not part of the UK; the question mark flags it as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Jersey is a Crown dependency, a territory self-governing but under the British Crown, so it exemplifies the term.
